documents.rightsNotes: The Constitution appears in the Rwanda Law Reform Commission's current Laws of Rwanda collection, which RLRC says is updated daily. A matching Parliament-hosted Official Gazette copy confirms the trilingual text, date and 176-Article structure. Do not rely on repealed Law No. 31/2009 for copyright status: Law No. 055/2024 repealed it and its Article 282 now contains the relevant exclusion for official legislative texts and official translations. Keep the source inactive and commercialUseAllowed=false until local counsel/publisher confirms that this exclusion covers CARTA's full-text web/mobile display, indexing, AI retrieval and offline caching, and verifies no other applicable restriction.
